title: Underlying abelian and normalized unit comparisons for integral ordinary inverse systems
statement: Let l be prime, f:X→Y a scheme morphism, and R_T the actual tower of constant rings Z/l^(n+1), with quotient maps [def-sp-tower-class-coefficients]. Let I_n be algebraic inverse images [lem-sp-proetale-algebraic-inverse-image] along the set inverse image of f [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] from R_Y,n to R_X,n, and let P be an OrdinaryInverseSystem for them [lem-coef-ordinary-inverse-system]. For any recorded forgetful functors F_Y,F_X [def-sp-tower-class-systems], there exist a natural isomorphism e:F_Y∘abPull(f)≅P.pull∘F_X and a coefficient-unit isomorphism i:P.pull(R_Y)≅R_X such that abPull(f)(integerGenerator_Y) followed by e and F_X(i) equals integerPull(f) followed by integerGenerator_X [lem-sp-tower-integral-class-pullback]. No Chern data, root comparison, Kummer morphism or K-flat assertion is included.

lean.statement:
theorem integralInverseSystem_normalization (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (I : ∀ n : ℕ, SheafOfModules.AlgebraicInverseImage
      (Scheme.proEtaleSheafInverseImage f (Type (u + 1)))
      ((Rrings l Y).obj (Opposite.op n)) ((Rrings l X).obj (Opposite.op n)))
    (P : WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.OrdinaryInverseSystem.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (fun n ↦ (Rrings l Y).obj (Opposite.op n))
      (fun n ↦ (Rrings l Y).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)
      (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (Scheme.proEtaleSheafInverseImage f (Type (u + 1)))
      (fun n ↦ (Rrings l X).obj (Opposite.op n))
      (fun n ↦ (Rrings l X).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) I)
    (FY : Forget Y (Rrings l Y)) (FX : Forget X (Rrings l X)) :
    ∃ e : FY.F ⋙ abPull f ≅ P.pull ⋙ FX.F,
      ∃ i : P.pull.obj (coefficient Y (Rrings l Y)) ≅ coefficient X (Rrings l X),
        (abPull f).map (integerGenerator Y (Rrings l Y) FY) ≫
          e.hom.app (coefficient Y (Rrings l Y)) ≫ FX.F.map i.hom =
        integerPull f ≫ integerGenerator X (Rrings l X) FX
